title: Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Uddanpul
extract: Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Uddanpul is in Nashik city, Dwarka area. It starts from Pandavleni caves and ends near Adgaon. It is India's first externally-strutted segmental box girder bridge. it has capacity of 100 Ton each and India's second-longest road bridge. It was approved by Atal Bihari Vajpayee in 2002.
